report_text: DATE: 12 Jan 2026
COUNTRY: India
SITE: Reliance Jamnagar Refinery Complex, Gujarat
REFINERY_ZONE: Crude Distillation Unit (CDU)
FUNCTION: Refining Operations
ACTIVITY: Production operations
CAUSE: Process upset / loss of containment potential
PRIMARY LIFE-SAVING RULE: Process safety / line of fire
NARRATIVE:
During routine CDU operation, operators observed an abnormal pressure rise on a crude preheat train. The control room initiated the approved response and reduced feed rate while field personnel verified valve and instrument status. No release or injury occurred. The event was escalated as a high-potential near miss because continued pressure escalation could have resulted in equipment damage and hydrocarbon release.
WHAT WENT WRONG:
The abnormal trend was not identified as early as expected during the initial operating review.
CORRECTIVE ACTIONS:
Review alarm response expectations, verify instrumentation health, and reinforce operating-envelope checks before continuing at normal throughput.
